target_verdicts.name: BanditRL.OnlineUnboundedOSD.phi_range

seven_slots.quantifiers: All alpha strictly between zero and one
seven_slots.source_scope_delta: Printed supplementary assertion remains required proof

target_verdicts.body_finding: Sets beta=1-alpha in (0,1), q(beta)=(1+beta)2^(-beta). Actual two derivatives prove concavity on [0,1]. Strict Bernoulli gives 2^beta<1+beta and q(beta)>1. Neither positivity nor the desired range is a premise.
